name: copy-file-and-line
description: Click a line number in the gutter to copy the file path and line number to the clipboard.

commands.title: Copy File and Line: Toggle Click-to-Copy

copyFileAndLine.enableClickToCopy.description: Copy file path and line number when you click a line number in the gutter (detected as a full-line mouse selection).

copyFileAndLine.format.markdownDescription: Clipboard format for a single line. Tokens: `${path}`, `${relativePath}`, `${fileName}`, `${line}`, `${column}`, `${lineText}`.

copyFileAndLine.rangeFormat.markdownDescription: Clipboard format when multiple lines are selected. Tokens: `${path}`, `${relativePath}`, `${fileName}`, `${startLine}`, `${endLine}`, `${lineText}`.

copyFileAndLine.useRelativePath.description: When true, ${path} resolves to the path relative to the workspace folder if available.
